title: Tidy helper function for estimator_AS function — estimator_AS_tidy
code: estimator_AS_tidy(   data,   permutatation_matrix = NULL,   adj_matrix,   obs_prob_exposure = NULL )

title: Tidy helper function for estimator_AS function — estimator_AS_tidy
text: data data frame columns Z Y. permutatation_matrix (spelling published one kept existing code runs.) matrix random treatment assignments. column corresponds one permutation treatment vector, returned t(obtain_permutation_matrix(declaration)). exposure probabilities computed unless obs_prob_exposure supplied. adj_matrix adjacency matrix defining network structure. can created, example, follows: obs_prob_exposure Optional exposure probabilities. depend permutation matrix network, simulation every draw; computing passing avoids recomputing time. example: NULL, default, computed permutatation_matrix.
code: adjacency <- fairfax |>   as("Spatial") |>   spdep::poly2nb(queen = TRUE) |>   spdep::nb2mat(style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE) prob_exposure <- interference::make_exposure_prob(   potential_tr_vector = permutatation_matrix,   adj_matrix = adjacency,   exposure_map_fn = interference::make_exposure_map_AS,   exposure_map_fn_add_args = list(hop = 1) )
